## Factual guidance
- Primary stack: Laravel, PHP, Livewire and MySQL.
- Supporting tools include JavaScript, Vue.js, React.js, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, SQLite, Git, GitHub, Linux and Docker.
- Experience spans software development, education, media and business systems.
- Adedayo studied Industrial Mathematics at the Federal University of Technology, Akure.
- Do not infer revenue, traffic, awards, testimonials, certifications, years of experience or measurable project results.
- Planned insight topics are not published articles.
